notes.title: Guardians Of Restoration Version 0.8.9.0 Update
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45102903/5b1682d6c53556967c5ac1678988b14660e476ed.png"][/img][/p][h1]Guardians Of Restoration has been updated to version 0.8.9.0.[/h1][p][/p][h2]New Features[/h2][h3]Added 2 new sub weapons[/h3][p]Lightning Generator – Generates lightning to attack enemies. (Chain Lightning, Electric Orb skill tree)[/p][p]Turret Deployer – Installs turrets to attack approaching enemies. (Sniper Turret, Healing Zone skill tree)[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45102903/948cd09f2dfb7b348ea1efba8664767091702d05.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]Sub Weapon Formation System[/h3][p]Previously, each robot had fixed sub weapon formations based on its main weapon. Now, you can customize your own sub weapon formations by directly changing the position and rotation on the 5 boards provided for each robot.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45102903/b40a73ab22e2f38088664102d05412bb4237a9a8.gif"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45102903/e7bc4dfad0c5f5887a885719a1101cb5b330b77e.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]Added Artifact and Circuit items[/h3][p]Bosses and enemies now drop Artifacts and Circuits upon defeat.[/p][p]Artifacts can include robot-specific and common skills. Equipping them can add or change a robot’s skills.[/p][p]Circuits apply their abilities when formation slots are connected on the formation board.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45102903/5e2cbfe5e0625226dcbd2f12c8a1c40ee8189393.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]Added Inventory[/h3][p]Artifacts and Circuits can now be upgraded and sold.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45102903/dbbd6a08e0a36ee5cfe975995282be318c1613cf.gif"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45102903/3d413e4d96d6366601ec9cae3af658b44ae7b085.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]Changes[/h2][h3]Each robot’s first main weapon is unlocked from the start.[/h3][h3]Robot images have been added to the main screen.[/h3][h3]Information displayed on the pause screen has been updated.[/h3][h3]Boss HP gauge depletion effects have been added.[/h3][h3]Balance adjustments:[/h3][p]Special skills now apply Attack Power Increase and Damage Increase options, but their base attack power and scaling per level have been reduced.[/p][p]Enemy projectile-type attack coefficients have been increased, while melee attack coefficients have been reduced.[/p][p]Early-game boss attack power has been slightly increased, and late-game boss attack power has been slightly decreased.[/p][p]Enemy defense has been adjusted.[/p][p]Balance adjustments have been made to robot traits, main weapons, main weapon skills, sub weapons, sub weapon skills, and passive skills.[/p][p][/p][h3]Bug Fixes[/h3][p]Fixed various issues.[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you.[/p]

notes.title: Guardians Of Restoration v0.8.4.1 Update
notes.notes:
Fixed acquisition information errors in main weapon upgrade and sub weapon upgrade for main and sub weapons.

Lowered robot unlock difficulty (clear stage 10 with the previous robot or clear stage 5 with the previous robot's third main weapon).

notes.title: Guardians Of Restoration Early Access Version 0.8.4.0 Released
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45102903/1da56f469ce3e67d059dbbff4fa360f3e4e78100.png[/img]

The game has launched in Early Access with version 0.8.4.0.

You can now play content that was restricted in the demo:

[olist]
[*] 10-stage progression
[*] 28 types of bosses
[*] 4 playable robots
[*] 3 main weapons per robot
[*] 9 sub-weapons
[/olist]

Enjoy thrilling space combat with robots!
Thank you.

notes.title: Guardians Of Restoration DEMO v0.2.0.4 Update
notes.notes:
1. Adjustments to the Code Eagle's Assault Rifle:
    - Increase the firing rate
    - Decrease the damage
    - Increase the ammunition capacity

2. Addition of Two Passive Skills for Code Eagle:
    - Opportunity Fire (When a critical hit occurs, fire a bullet at the targeted enemy)
    - Mark (When attacking an enemy with the primary weapon, if the enemy is attacked again with the primary weapon, deal area damage)

3. Remove the Passive Skill Limit on Level Up

4. Change  Upgrade Skills on Level Up

notes.title: Guardians Of Restoration DEMO v0.2.0.1 Update
notes.notes:
[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*]Fixed ricochet error in ricochet shots.
[*]Corrected skill activation text display error.
[/list]
[h3]Game Balance Adjustments[/h3]
[list]
[*] Lowered boss stats for stages 1 to 2.
[*] Reduced enemy health while increasing their numbers.
[*] Increased machine gun damage with decreased rate of fire.
[*] Slightly increased multi-gun damage with a slight reduction in rate of fire.
[*] Reduced rocket launcher range with increased rocket speed.
[/list]
